items.en: Focusing on sustainability, METCHA's project aimed to be carbon neutral. Using modern content delivery techniques — green distributed networks like Cloudflare, code splitting, and progressive loading — we served only the code needed by the UI in real-time, while maintaining 100% semantic HTML for accessibility and SEO.
items.current: Em março de 2022, ajudei a levar o conteúdo do METCHA para o GIPHY, aumentando o alcance do projeto.

items.en: To adapt the project to international privacy rules we also developed a first-party 100% anonymous data collection tool for the project, called smart-data.
items.current: Para adaptar o projeto às normas internacionais de privacidade, desenvolvemos uma ferramenta própria de coleta de dados 100% anônima, chamada smart-data.

items.en: The main script contained a simple and very lightweight Javascript code to be initialized when the website is loaded. Then sending anonymous page views, that are stored and counted on the database, with the data sent from and to the API.
items.current: O script principal contém um código JavaScript simples e extremamente leve que inicia ao carregar o site, enviando visualizações de página anônimas armazenadas no banco de dados através da API.

items.en: On the database, all daily data is gathered in a table without any information that can identify a user, 100% anonymous. At the end of the day, the table is consolidated and all the information is stored in a new table with a field to identify the event and the URL.
items.current: No banco de dados, todos os dados diários são reunidos em uma tabela sem qualquer informação que possa identificar o usuário, 100% anônimo. Ao final do dia, a tabela é consolidada e gravada em uma nova tabela com o tipo de evento e URL.

items.en: Then on METCHA's CMS, we create another script connecting to the API (PHP), and rendering via Javascript all the data in Numbers that make sense to the user, like the number of page views in a given interval of time, and creating some useful graphs like the session duration, which page had more clicks on a button, etc.

items.en: Sage is a fiscal software developed by Genesysinf, based in Santana do Livramento, Brazil.

items.en: I worked on the new Sageweb version — built in C# and ASP.NET — as a full-stack developer embedded in the development team for one year.
items.current: Trabalhei na versão Sageweb — desenvolvida em C# e ASP.NET — como desenvolvedor full-stack por um ano.
